# Application (ONTAP REST API 9.16, GET only)

> Source: NetApp's **ontap-mcp** API catalog for **ONTAP 9.16** (github.com/NetApp/ontap-mcp, Apache-2.0, see NOTICE.md). It lists **GET endpoints only**, with their filters and fields. | `delete_data` |  | Should application storage elements be deleted? An application is considered to use storage elements from a shared storage pool. Possible values are 'true' and 'false'. If the value is 'true', the application will be… |
| `generation` |  | The generation number of the application. This indicates which features are supported on the application. For example, generation 1 applications do not support Snapshot copies. Support for Snapshot copies was added at… |
| `name` |  | Application Name. This field is user supplied when the application is created. |
| `protection_granularity` |  | Protection granularity determines the scope of Snapshot copy operations for the application. Possible values are "application" and "component". If the value is "application", Snapshot copy operations are performed on… |
| `smart_container` |  | Identifies if this is a smart container or not. |
| `state` |  | The state of the application. For full functionality, applications must be in the online state. Other states indicate that the application is in a transient state and not all operations are supported. |
| `uuid` |  | Application UUID. This field is generated when the application is created. |

## GET `/api/application/templates`

**Tier:** T0 · **since ONTAP** 9.6

Retrieves application templates. ### Query examples The most useful queries on this API allows searches by name or protocol access. The following query returns all templates that are used to provision
